name: Get feature toggles
description: Call this when you need to know which feature flags are enabled for the current Brevo account, for example to adjust UI behavior. Use a more specific feature‑check endpoint if one exists for the particular capability you are interested in.

bots-tracking.description: Indicates whether bot tracking is enabled.

compliance-allowed.description: Indicates whether compliance features are allowed.

dedup-customization-enabled.description: Indicates whether deduplication customization is enabled.

duplicate-identifiers.description: Indicates whether duplicate identifiers are permitted.

editor-beta.description: Indicates whether the editor beta features are enabled.

email-campaign-duplicate.description: Indicates whether duplicate email campaigns are allowed.

email-campaigns-limit-disabled.description: Indicates whether limits on email campaigns are disabled.

ent-users-push-experiment.description: Indicates whether the enterprise users push experiment is active.

es-new-sender-domain.description: Indicates whether the new sender domain feature for ElasticSearch is enabled.

is-webpush-enabled.description: Indicates whether web push notifications are enabled.

marketing-subject-ai-disabled.description: Indicates whether AI assistance for marketing subject lines is disabled.

mpp-opens-tracking.description: Indicates whether MPP opens tracking is enabled.

new-conversions.description: Indicates whether the new conversions tracking is enabled.

new-signup-flow.description: Indicates whether the new signup flow is enabled.

new_marketing_pressure_enabled.description: Indicates whether new marketing pressure controls are enabled.

plan-management-service.description: Indicates whether the plan management service is active.

preview-on-email-clients.description: Indicates whether preview on email clients is enabled.

self-serve-users-push-experiment.description: Indicates whether the self‑serve users push experiment is active.

wallet-rollout.description: Indicates whether the wallet rollout feature is enabled.
